Supreme Court Suspends Godhra Train Burning Convict's Life Sentence on Medical Grounds

The Supreme Court has suspended the life sentence of a convict in the 2002 Godhra train burning case on medical grounds. The convict had been in jail for 18 years, having been convicted by a trial court in March 2011 along with several others. The court granted this relief after two decades.
